cases.document:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Relative Server
  description: A YAML document whose server URL is relative.
servers:
  - url: ../v2
paths:
  /pets/{petId}:
    parameters:
      - name: petId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string }
    get:
      operationId: getPet
      summary: Get a pet
      tags: [pets]
      parameters:
        - name: verbose
          in: query
          schema: { type: boolean }
        - name: X-Trace
          in: header
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: session
          in: cookie
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: A pet
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  id: { type: string }
                  age: { type: integer }
        default:
          description: Anything else
        "2XX":
          description: A wildcard
    trace:
      summary: Not a Vayu verb
      responses:
        "200": { description: ok }
